hull.line: No name there on no hull
stanza: No boat out on no ocean
No name there on no hull
And it's not a strain at all to remember
Those that I've left behind
They're all standing right here beside me now
And most of them with a smile

hull.line: I'll break the ice in your skull, throw your corpse off the hull
hull.linePrev: I'll give you a splinter with a dull icicle
hull.lineNext: You'll feed the seagulls, my words should be illegal I'm so lethal

hull.songTitle: There She Goes, My Beautiful World
stanza: While Philip Larkin stuck it out
In a library in Hull
And Dylan Thomas died drunk in
St. Vincent's hospital

hull.line: Then I hear a noise from the hull
stanza: And in the trough of the waves
Which are pawing like dogs
Pitch we, pale-faced and grave
As I write in my log
Then I hear a noise from the hull
Seven days out to sea
And it is the damnable bell!
And it tolls — well, I believe that it tolls — it tolls for me!
And it tolls for me!

skull.line: Blowing like a circle around my skull
stanza: Idiot wind
Blowing like a circle around my skull
From the Grand Coulee Dam to the Capitol
Idiot wind
Blowing every time you move your teeth
You’re an idiot, babe
It’s a wonder that you still know how to breathe

skull.line: Signs and wonders: Perseus aligned with the skull
stanza: The only thing that keeps me from driving this car
Half-light, jack knife into the canyon at night
Signs and wonders: Perseus aligned with the skull
Slain Medusa, Pegasus alight from us all

skull.line: Bring me some water, put it in this skull
stanza: Well, hell doesn't want you and heaven is full
Bring me some water, put it in this skull
I walk between the raindrops, I wait in bug house square
And the army ants, they leave nothin' but the bones

skull.line: When you cut a hole into my skull
stanza: Pulling thorns out of my palm
Work a midnight surgery
When you cut a hole into my skull
Do you hate what you see like I do?

skull.line: Dick could roll the eyes back in the skull
skull.linePrev: Remote controller on your lower back, yes, the good

stanza: Now you see them, now you don’t
Children vanish ‘hind vehicle
Now you see them, now you don’t
Faces, limbs, a bouncing skull
